description: This file defines a Java class RetrieveLoggerConfig, which implements a command to retrieve logger configurations within the Eclipse Ditto DevOps framework. It includes methods for constructing command instances, parsing from JSON, and handling command payload details.

classes.name: RetrieveLoggerConfig
classes.description: An immutable class representing a command to retrieve logger configurations, supporting various construction methods, JSON serialization/deserialization, and command payload management.

methods.name: ofAllKnownLoggers
methods.description: Creates a command instance to retrieve all known loggers, with optional service name and headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a command instance to retrieve specific loggers, either with headers and specific logger list or with service and instance names.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a RetrieveLoggerConfig command instance.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Adds command payload fields to a JSON object builder based on command data and schema version.
